outcome_blind_attestation: frozen after literature search (a6_search_log.json) and before any candidate return/PnL/PF/Sharpe/ranking existed or was read; V11 budget 0/12
family_name: Open-interest positioning-saturation (hedging-pressure analog) on crypto perpetuals
mechanism: futures risk premia accrue to the side opposite prevailing positioning pressure (de Roon-Nijman-Veld hedging-pressure channel); perp OI growth in excess of the contemporaneous price move marks fresh leveraged demand, and crowded coins underperform while deleveraged coins outperform
expected_counterparty: over-leveraged directional speculators who must de-risk into thin books, paying price impact and (typically net-long) funding

literature.citation: de Roon, Nijman, Veld (2000), Journal of Finance 55(3), 1437-1456
literature.claim_used: futures risk premia depend on own-market and cross-market hedging pressure (mechanism source)

literature.citation: Dunbar, Owusu-Amoako (2023), Finance Research Letters 55(B), art. 104009
literature.claim_used: hedging factor from futures positioning significantly predicts crypto returns (CFTC positioning version; perp-OI proxy must re-earn it)
market-structure evidence only: perps deliver leveraged exposure with little capital; speculative OI large and dynamic. Its carry mechanism is banned and NOT used

literature.citation: Binance USD-M market data docs (= frozen packet source S4)
literature.claim_used: OI snapshot endpoint semantics, completed 15m klines, funding settlement cadence

feature_contract.bars: completed 15m base bars -> daily UTC closes (coin + BTC) for orthogonalisation and residualisation only
feature_contract.oi: per-symbol OI snapshots from staged snapshot at published timestamps; declared staleness lag: latest snapshot published >=24h before decision
feature_contract.anchor_feature: OIGRTH_i = 28d delta-log(OI) z-score; SAT_i = cross-sectional regression residual of OIGRTH on trailing 28d coin return at decision T (PIT-safe, sign-free removal of price component)
feature_contract.neighbour_feature: OI LEVEL percentile of own trailing 90d history (stock-of-positions saturation)
feature_contract.excluded_fields: funding rate and traded volume never enter any signal field (anti-carry, anti-volume-shock guards)
feature_contract.pit_lag: decision 00:05 UTC at each 28d cycle start; ONE declared execution lag (fill at first completed 15m bar after decision); OI coverage gaps fail closed, no synthesis

anchor.name: POS-OIGRTH-28D-M
anchor.book: long bottom tercile / short top tercile of return-orthogonalised 28d OI growth (SAT), equal weight, gross 1.0 (0.5/0.5)

neighbour.name: POS-OILEVEL-90D-M
neighbour.book: long low / short high OI percentile of own 90d history (stock vs flow of the same latent hedging-pressure state, per de Roon et al.)

causal_negative_control.name: POS-OIGRTH-28D-M-INV
causal_negative_control.falsification: any positive after-cost spread on the inverted book destroys the crowding mechanism claim (would imply continuation, not positioning-premium)

schedule.floors: 13/365d <= 60; 28d >= 3d; estimated base drag 1-2%/yr <= 8%; stressed 2-3%/yr <= 12%; per-symbol turnover share target well under 25%, verified by A3 gate pre-score

universe_and_benchmark.universe: Binance USD-M staged snapshot; >=90d bar history AND >=60d OI coverage at declared cadence; declared median daily dollar-volume tradability floor; BTC/ETH retained; fail-closed eligibility
universe_and_benchmark.benchmark_role: BTC = residualisation/market context (rolling 90d beta, frozen packet rule); family benchmark = equal-weight universe; claim is the positioning-conditioned spread, beta-neutral by construction

risk_neutralisation: BTC-beta neutral legs via rolling 90d beta
trailing-return component explicitly orthogonalised out of the sort key (no momentum tilt by construction)
minimum 6 names per leg, else decision fails closed
expected_sign: anchor net spread > 0 (low minus high orthogonalised OI growth, after costs and funding); neighbour net spread > 0; inverted control <= 0
falsification_condition: positive after-cost spread on POS-OIGRTH-28D-M-INV, or non-positive after-cost anchor spread; published returns are priors only
cost_treatment: adapter taker fees + adverse-tick slippage per side (frozen arithmetic), native funding charged while held (LONG_PAYS_POSITIVE_RATE, ~84 settlements per 28d holding); disclosed tailwind: crowded-long coins often carry positive funding so the short leg may receive funding (part of counterparty cost, never a signal); A3 schedule-only cost gate before any scoring

ancestry_and_orthogonality.v1_v10_families: no OI-sorted ancestor known; M01 (aggressor-flow absorption) shares no input (trade-side flow vs stock of open positions), horizon or schedule
ancestry_and_orthogonality.vs_banned: not trend/momentum (trailing return sign-free orthogonalised OUT; expected sign anti-crowding); not reversal/residual mean-reversion (no price mean-reversion signal, return only a removed control); not funding carry (funding never in signal); not volume-shock continuation (volume never enters; OI is a stock, sign opposite to continuation); not weekly reversal
ancestry_and_orthogonality.reserved_seeds: DEF-RESIDUAL-RISK and LOTTERY-MAX-SKEW sort return moments (residual vol, MAX/skew); this family sorts a positioning quantity
ancestry_and_orthogonality.orthogonality_argument: SAT residual conditions on the return path; Stage-A A7-N gate must confirm low book-weight rho vs both seed books; within-volatility-bucket spread diagnostic (diagnostic only, no new arm) guards against repackaged low-vol or anti-lottery
ancestry_and_orthogonality.disclosed_overlap_risk: OI surges co-occur with high-vol, high-MAX episodes

data_readiness_and_estimate.data: OI snapshots + completed 15m bars in frozen staged snapshot; no new external data
data_readiness_and_estimate.open_readiness_risk: depth/cadence of staged OI history over the scored window must be validated with coverage diagnostics ONLY (fail-closed per lesson L-V10P-COVERAGE) before implementation; if too shallow for 28d/90d features the family fails closed rather than being re-cut post-hoc
data_readiness_and_estimate.implementation_estimate: plugin on GenericStrategyBase; new code = OI snapshot loader, delta-log-OI feature, cross-sectional orthogonalisation, bucket book builder; 2-3 working days incl. coverage validation + A3 gate run

not_a_rescue.vs_m01: no shared input, horizon or schedule; opposite cost regime (13 decisions/yr, floors verified pre-score)
not_a_rescue.vs_banned: not a funding-carry rescue (no funding signal, no carry harvest); not a crowding rescue of any rejected book (open interest belongs to no prior repo family known to this lane; crowding here is the mechanism itself, priced via the de Roon et al. channel, not a patch for a dead signal); not volume-shock continuation; not reversal at any horizon; not a re-cut lookback/threshold of the reserved seeds (different sort key, data type and counterparty)
